featured_reviews.name: Titiksha Laul
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best restaurants in vasai, nallasopara and virar area. Just 2 mins walk from nallasopara station. This restaurant is very very pocket friendly. It serves phenomenol vegetarian and non vegetarian dishes including starters and main course.
The seating arrangement of the restaurant is very simple but the food is delicious.
A person can have stomach full of food in just 60-70rs here, the rates are that cheap, also because it serves half quantity of food of most of the dishes from the menu.
This restaurant has a family ac section also.
They also take large catering orders.

The dishes worth trying here are-

Chicken Biryani

Chicken Masala

Chicken korma

Chicken tandoori

Paneer butter masala

Butter garlic naan

I would definitely recommend this pocket friendly place to all the goodies out there.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Specially the price of chicken biryani is very low for a plate.

Kids friendly family restaurant.

featured_reviews.review_text:
In this world of Eat, Snap & Repeat, pictures of food are keeping us sane. So it feels incomplete to have something and not let Instagram know. And if we are doing it, the world is doing it.

One day your best friend or your favorite food blogger posts a mouth-watering picture of their recent cooking experiment, and the other day your crush uploads a picture of a decadent dish. In all this, if you keep wondering what to comment on these food posts, we have got your back.

We present a list of nice food comments that describe your feelings when you see a food post popping up on your news feed.

We understand why and how the comments should be personalized, so we’ve narrowed dwn a list to save you time. Here are some interesting comments for food posts that can be your ultimate guide.

featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:

The ambiance is perfect for enjoying thoughtful, tasty, and freshly prepared vegetarian cuisine.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐😊

Thank you for choosing Keniz Kitchen. We look forward to serving you again soon! ❤️🍽️

featured_reviews.name: Shruti Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst food ever i tried....
I visited Central Point Hotel today with my husband and my 5-month-old baby, and it was a very disappointing and unacceptable experience.
We ordered Paneer Chilli, Triple Fried Rice, and a half-liter Thums Up. The food was served cold, and the Manchurian gravy had a foul smell, clearly indicating that it was not fresh.
The most shocking part was that when we raised this issue, the staff themselves said, “This is party food, ma’am, it is fresh.” This clearly means we were served leftover food from a party, which is completely unacceptable.
When we showed them that the food was smelling bad, instead of addressing the issue, three staff members went aside, started talking among themselves while looking at us, and made strange and disrespectful facial expressions. This behavior was extremely unprofessional and insulting.
When we complained further, the staff behaved in a very rude and arrogant manner. Instead of resolving the issue, they argued with us and refused to take responsibility.
Additionally, the electricity went off four times during our visit, which made the experience even worse.
The most disturbing part was that while I was breastfeeding my baby, the staff was staring in an inappropriate and disrespectful way, which made me extremely uncomfortable.
Overall, the food quality was very poor, the service was slow and disrespectful, and the entire experience was extremely disappointing.
I would strongly not recommend this place, especially for families. Strict action should be taken to improve their service, hygiene, and staff behavior.

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Naik
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was a genuine and loyal customer of Radhe Krishna Hotel, but after this experience, I will not be placing any further orders.
The restaurant appears to have no accountability for food quality. I ordered Paneer Butter Masala, yet received an overly spicy dish made with stale paneer—something I have never experienced in my life with this preparation.
As for the rotis, the condition speaks for itself. Please refer to the attached images. The quality was completely unacceptable and clearly not fresh or fit for consumption.
When I requested a refund, there was no proper evaluation or fair resolution from Swiggy’s end either. This raises serious concerns about the absence of an effective quality-check and customer protection mechanism.
This entire experience has been extremely disappointing and unacceptable.
I will never order again from Radhe Krishna Hotel.
Further, as an FSSAI Management student, I consider this a serious food safety lapse and will be formally escalating this matter to the concerned FSSAI authorities.

featured_reviews.name: HARDIK SINGH
featured_reviews.review_text: Very disappointing experience at Radhe Krishna Pure Veg Restaurant. The food quality was extremely poor — the paneer tasted old and stale, which made the dish unpleasant. The overall atmosphere of the restaurant was not comfortable or hygienic. Additionally, the washroom was in very bad condition and clearly not maintained properly. This is a restaurant (not a hotel), and even for a basic dining place, the standards were far below expectations. Would not recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Neha Shettigar
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered pav bhaji directly from the hotel and picked it up myself since they couldn’t deliver. Unfortunately, the experience was disappointing the pav was stale and not soft at all, and the bhaji was overly diluted, lacking any real flavor. Compared to this, Regency’s/Surbhi’s pav bhaji is far more tasty and satisfying.
